text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, as Wonder Acute and I were walking
down the hallway on our way to training...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: ...My head hurts a bit, you see.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, hey, you'll be fine.
Just stick a pickled plum on your temple and it'll cure right up."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Go on ahead to the track. I'll catch up soon. ...Ow ow ow.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seems Wonder Acute is suffering from a headache...
